cases.name: postgres-event-store-valid

cases.name: tenancy-long-key-explicit-role

cases.name: tenancy-derived-role-valid

cases.name: tenancy-explicit-role-too-long

cases.name: redis-cache-valid

cases.name: redis-retained-state-without-persistence
cases.description: Retained state cannot disable persistence.

cases.name: redis-reader-single-zone
cases.description: Dedicated reader capability requires multi-zone availability.

cases.name: node-contract-valid
cases.description: A bounded scheduling and disruption contract is accepted.

cases.name: node-capacity-invalid

cases.name: postgres-binding-valid

cases.name: postgres-binding-reader-mismatch

cases.name: preview-tunnel-single
cases.description: The single-hostname inputs publish one hostname through one tunnel.

cases.name: preview-tunnel-multi-zone
cases.description: Hostnames across different zones share one tunnel.

cases.name: preview-tunnel-combined
cases.description: The single-hostname input combines with additional hostnames on one tunnel.

cases.name: preview-tunnel-duplicate-hostname
cases.description: Duplicate hostnames are rejected case-insensitively.

cases.name: preview-tunnel-missing-origin
cases.description: A hostname with no origin of its own and no default origin is rejected.

cases.name: preview-tunnel-no-hostname
cases.description: At least one published hostname is required.

cases.name: preview-tunnel-entry-origin-invalid

cases.name: preview-tunnel-empty-origin

cases.name: preview-tunnel-dns-unmanaged
cases.description: DNS ownership can be delegated while the tunnel still serves every hostname.

cases.name: gcp-ci-oidc-exact-only

cases.name: gcp-ci-oidc-wildcard-only
cases.description: A wildcard condition becomes an anchored RE2 matches call.

cases.name: gcp-ci-oidc-combined
cases.description: Exact and wildcard conditions combine under AND in input order.

cases.name: gcp-ci-oidc-multi-value-or
cases.description: Values within one condition are parenthesized alternatives under AND.

cases.name: gcp-ci-oidc-re2-escaping
cases.description: RE2 metacharacters in literal glob segments are escaped; only * and ? widen.

cases.name: gcp-ci-oidc-name-too-long

cases.name: gcp-ci-oidc-pool-id-too-long
cases.description: A derived workload identity pool ID violating GCP naming rules is rejected.

cases.name: gcp-ci-oidc-reserved-prefix
cases.description: A pool ID starting with the reserved gcp- prefix is rejected.

cases.name: gcp-ci-oidc-unsupported-match
cases.description: An unknown match kind is rejected by the contract before translation.

cases.name: gcp-ci-oidc-claim-not-identifier
cases.description: A claim that is not a CEL-safe identifier is rejected at plan time.

cases.name: gke-ci-oidc-rbac-admin-off

cases.description: Enabling the grant creates exactly one custom role bound to the deploy identity.

cases.name: gke-ci-oidc-rbac-admin-role-id-invalid
cases.description: A role ID outside GCP's custom-role character set is rejected.

cases.name: gke-ci-oidc-rbac-admin-role-id-too-long
cases.description: A role ID over GCP's 64-character custom-role limit is rejected.

cases.name: karpenter-prereqs-canonical-role

cases.name: gke-cluster-name-at-limit

cases.name: gke-cluster-name-too-long

cases.name: gke-cluster-name-invalid-shape
cases.description: A derived cluster name violating RFC 1035 shape is rejected.

cases.name: gke-cluster-location-regional-default
cases.description: The default location mode keeps the control plane regional and nodes in the selected zone.

cases.name: gke-cluster-location-zonal
cases.description: Zonal mode places the control plane in the selected zone without setting node_locations.

cases.name: gke-cluster-location-mode-invalid
cases.description: Unsupported control-plane location modes are rejected.

cases.name: gke-nodepool-location-zonal
cases.description: A zonal cluster self-link and explicit location plan a nodepool in that zone.

cases.name: gke-nodepool-location-mismatch
cases.description: A zonal cluster self-link with the regional default location fails its lifecycle precondition.

cases.name: gke-nodepool-location-unknown-self-link
cases.description: A nodepool with an explicit location plans when the cluster self-link is unknown until apply.

cases.name: gke-nodepool-size-autoscaled-default
cases.description: Without node_count the cluster autoscaler owns the pool's size between its minimum and maximum.

cases.name: gke-nodepool-size-fixed-zero

cases.name: gke-nodepool-size-negative
cases.description: A negative node_count is rejected.

cases.name: gke-nodepool-size-fractional
cases.description: A fractional node_count is rejected.

cases.name: gke-nodepool-size-fixed-three
cases.description: A nonzero node_count holds the pool at that size with no autoscaling block.

cases.name: eks-cluster-name-at-limit
cases.description: A cluster name at the EKS 100-character limit is accepted.

cases.name: eks-cluster-name-too-long
cases.description: A cluster name over the EKS 100-character limit is rejected.

cases.name: eks-cluster-name-invalid-shape
cases.description: A cluster name outside the EKS character set is rejected.

cases.name: eks-role-name-at-limit
cases.description: A derived IAM role name at the 64-character limit is accepted.

cases.name: eks-role-name-too-long
cases.description: A derived IAM role name over the 64-character limit is rejected.

cases.name: cloudsql-activation-policy-never
cases.description: NEVER stops the primary instance while keeping it.

cases.name: cloudsql-activation-policy-on-demand
cases.description: The deprecated ON_DEMAND policy is rejected.

cases.description: The controller release module keeps the image inputs' mutual exclusion.
